data.evidence_scope: v1 visual-identity-core, wiki visual-guidelines, brand-config visual_preferences, existing assets F3.
data.essence_fr: Précision réglementaire + signal de validation — esthétique fonctionnelle, sans bruit.
data.essence_en: Regulatory precision + validation signal — functional aesthetic, no visual noise.

theme.name: Signal in the System
theme.metaphor: High-precision instrument panel — every signal clear, every threshold visible, every action traceable

visual_principles: Every element serves a functional purpose — decoration avoided
Show product/document proof before lifestyle mood
Make claim limitations legible where outcomes could be inferred
FR market framing in imagery captions (CEE desk, not generic US startup loft)

photography.style: Documentary precision — real regulatory documents, real desks, real processes
photography.avoid: Stock-photo smiling humans, consumer renovation lifestyle, competitor primes creatives
photography.approved_reuse: og-image.png and screenshot-hero.png only in this run; no new generation authorized unless founder requests

illustration.style: Technical diagrams with Swiss precision — clean lines, minimal color, information-first
illustration.color_limit: Signal Green sparingly on Regulatory Stone / Clean White fields

environments: Neutral tones with green accent lighting

graphic_elements.shapes: Sharp corners, precise angles, grid-aligned; no rounded corners on data elements
graphic_elements.textures: Fine-grain stone paper, brushed aluminum, circuit traces — subtle, never dominant
graphic_elements.patterns: Grid systems, document flow diagrams, validation checkmark motifs

principles: Product and dossier context before brand theatre
Bilingual layouts: FR default, EN twin — same visual system

forbidden_visuals: Hype gradients and generic SaaS blue (#2563EB)
Consumer primes shopping imagery that confuses category with Hellio/Effy
Synthetic UI presented as live customer proof without label
